text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text in a useful way. For example, NLP can translate words from one language into another quickly and accurately. It can also perform sentiment analysis, which means it recognises whether a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. This is very helpful for companies that want to know what customers think about their products. In addition, NLP powers chatbots, which are computer programs that can chat with people and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, our interaction with technology is becoming easier and more natural every day.
